name: Ganz transformer electricity distribution
description: A Budapest engineering team and firm developed transformer-based AC distribution and supplied exhibition and city lighting.

impact.note: Installed in many European cities and copied in later grids; transformers made distribution over distance practical, and alternating-current supply grew from it.

places.note: Place is a modern geographic reference to the cited episode; it does not imply exclusive origin.

events.statement: The Ganz transformer distribution system powered lighting at the Budapest exhibition.
events.caveats: The Ganz-affiliated author’s retrospective describes exhibition use; no global-first claim is adopted.

evidence.supports: The Ganz transformer distribution system powered lighting at the Budapest exhibition.
